subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir used his Glabbagool arm to steal the potion of flying from Alkrist's safe during the chaos, while others were distracted; he acted without detection and concealed the item beneath his skin.
source_quote: Under the skin of my arm, Glabbagool liked the flying skill. He thought it was a good skill.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch was reinstated as head of the Avowed after being persuaded by the manipulative leader; he now claims credit for the adventurers' actions and speaks of Janussi’s death with performative grief.
source_quote: Kalan gathered us to escort us out, very full of himself now, going on about how our actions had proven the value of his methods — one more man very heartbroken over Janussi's untimely death. What a great man. What a tragedy for the community.

subject: The Leader of the Avowed
fact: The Leader of the Avowed feigned shock and sorrow over Janussi’s death while secretly orchestrating the removal of the adventurers from influence; she sincerely fears for their safety but is delighted to have them contained and out of the way.
source_quote: I looked at her while she said it and found, underneath, that she meant the worry. It was real — she was sincerely afraid something would happen to us. Daz found the other half, the half I only saw land on his face: she was delighted to have us wrapped up and out of everything, no more heads poking anywhere. Win and win. She had built a box and we had walked into it.

subject: The Avowed
fact: The Avowed is a hierarchical organization undergoing leadership transition; internal power struggles are masked by public rituals of mourning and procedural formality, with members like Kalan and the Leader manipulating outcomes under the guise of justice.
source_quote: That will be done after the naming, by the new head of the Avowed.

subject: Opening of Alkrist's Safe
fact: The safe containing Alkrist’s possessions was opened and revealed a potion of flying, a healing potion, a heap of gold coins, and one red coin stamped with a herring — the only tangible clue, which was later identified as a red herring.
source_quote: Inside: a potion of flying, a healing potion, a heap of gold coins, and nothing at all that pointed anywhere. Thorin asked whether there was a red herring in there. There was, in fact — one of the coins had a herring stamped on it, and it was red.

subject: Red Herring Coin
fact: One gold coin from Alkrist's safe bore a red herring stamp — a deliberate misdirection planted to obscure the true nature of the crime or the identity of the perpetrator.
source_quote: Thorin asked whether there was a red herring in there. There was, in fact — one of the coins had a herring stamped on it, and it was red.

subject: Potion of Flying
fact: The potion of flying was stolen from Alkrist's safe by Zalthir using his Glabbagool arm during the distraction; it was removed without detection and is now concealed within his body.
source_quote: I had my Glabbagool arm swipe the potion of flying off the table... Under the skin of my arm, Glabbagool liked the flying skill.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, the sentient arm of Zalthir, possesses autonomous agency and desires magical abilities; it actively sought and consumed the potion of flying, evaluating it as a 'good skill.'
source_quote: Under the skin of my arm, Glabbagool liked the flying skill. He thought it was a good skill.

subject: Identity of Janussi’s Killer
fact: The true killer of Janussi remains unknown; the group suspects Alkrist may have been framed, and the involvement of a polymorphing agent or accomplice is unconfirmed.
source_quote: We don't know who did the poly… I mean, she may or may not have done the polymorphing. We don't know that part.

subject: The Accomplice Conspiracy
fact: The group acknowledges the existence of accomplices in Janussi’s death but lacks evidence to identify them; the Leader exploited this ambiguity to deflect blame and consolidate control.
source_quote: Yeah — we know there are accomplices," I said.

subject: Deneir's Sanctum
fact: Deneir's Sanctum is the designated destination for the adventurers after the confrontation; it serves as a place of temporary confinement under the pretense of protection.
source_quote: I will now ask Kalan Strongbranch to escort you to Deneir's Sanctum.

subject: Session Date
fact: The events occurred on the day of the naming ceremony, immediately preceding the formal transition of leadership in the Avowed.
source_quote: That will be done after the naming, by the new head of the Avowed.

subject: Alkrist
fact: Alkrist is held securely in the prisons and accused of a grave crime, but evidence against him is circumstantial and potentially planted; he is the designated scapegoat in a larger political maneuver.
source_quote: Alkrist held secure in the prisons.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is perceptive and attuned to hidden motives; he recognized the Leader’s dual intent — genuine concern and calculated containment — and interpreted the situation as a strategic trap.
source_quote: Daz found the other half, the half I only saw land on his face: she was delighted to have us wrapped up and out of everything, no more heads poking anywhere.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is opportunistic and cynical; he recognized the red herring and encouraged the group to question the validity of evidence, while also praising Zalthir’s theft as a successful grift.
source_quote: Never miss an opportunity to grift, man," Thorin said.

subject: Healing Potion
fact: A healing potion was found in Alkrist’s safe, but its origin and intended use remain unexplored; it was deemed irrelevant and left untouched after the safe was opened.
source_quote: Inside: a potion of flying, a healing potion, a heap of gold coins...

subject: Prisons of the Avowed
fact: The Prisons of the Avowed are where Alkrist is held under heavy guard; they serve as a tool of political control and a stage for public spectacle rather than genuine justice.
source_quote: Alkrist held secure in the prisons.

subject: The Missing Sapphire
fact: Zalthir attempted to use a Locate Object spell to determine if the Leader possessed a sapphire, but the spell found nothing; the absence suggests either she does not have it or the spell was blocked.
source_quote: I wanted to know if she had one on her — that would have been interesting. The spell went out and found nothing. She did not have it.

subject: The Accusation of Alkrist
fact: Alkrist was publicly accused of a grave crime by the Leader, based on unverified testimony from an unnamed source; the accusation was used to redirect suspicion away from the true conspirators.
source_quote: She had named her the mastermind. Thin.

subject: Janussi
fact: Janussi is portrayed as a beloved and tragic figure whose death catalyzed the political upheaval; his public image is weaponized to manipulate emotion and justify control.
source_quote: This is just awful. I can't believe there would be accomplices in the death of such a great man as Janussi — beloved by all.
